name: MEGAKO☆PUNCH!
description:
About This Game

MEGAKO☆PUNCH! is a Blackjack-inspired deckbuilding roguelite!

Hit exactly 21 to unleash devastating Ultimate Cards, then chain together relentless attacks and send monsters flying!

Plan your actions—then unleash them all at once!

Instead of playing cards directly from your hand, flip cards from your deck one by one. Once you're happy with your setup, lock in your actions!

Just like in Blackjack, if the total Cost of the cards you've flipped exceeds 21, you Bust and lose your entire turn!

But hit exactly 21, and you'll add a powerful Ultimate Card to your hand! Don't get too greedy—but when the moment is right, don't be afraid to push your luck!

Control your strategy with Energy!

Spend Energy to return flipped cards to your hand and save them for later. Cards in your hand can be played at any time without spending Energy.

Flipping new cards from your deck also costs Energy. Do you keep digging for more options, or refine your current setup? Every decision shapes your strategy.

The best defense is an overwhelming offense!

Enemy actions are protected by Shield. Deal enough damage to break through it and cancel their actions!

Keep your combo going, chain attack after attack, and finish the battle before your enemies get a chance to strike back!

Collect Items and unlock new Ultimate Cards!

Defeated monsters occasionally drop special Items.

Each Item comes with unique conditions that unlock new Ultimate Cards, giving you even more powerful ways to dominate the battlefield!

From multi-hit builds centered around Drills to Missile strategies that thrive on large hands, every Item opens up new deckbuilding possibilities. Build around the Items you find, unlock devastating Ultimate Cards, and wipe out every monster in your path!

Short. Intense. Endlessly Replayable.

Each run takes about 20 minutes. This compact deckbuilding roguelite features one Story stage and three challenging stages.

Beat the game to unlock Sandbox Mode, where you can take on even greater challenges!

Discover devastating combos and build your perfect deck!
short_desc: A Blackjack-inspired deckbuilding roguelite! Hit exactly 21 to unleash powerful Ultimate Cards! Beat your enemies to a pulp with utterly broken combos!
